extra_control: - `{control}` is not one of the controls given.
missing_item: - item `{item}` of control {control} is not marked.
extra_item: - `{item}` is not one of control {control}'s items.
item_value: - each item must be marked "shown" or "not_shown".
empty_why: - `why` must be one sentence naming what decides each not_shown, or empty when every item is shown.
extra_key: - `{key}` is not a key of the shape asked.
